_comment: Shared BEHAVIOURAL pin for the two implementations of 'which plugin-root references does this skill
point at': resolveRootReferences in src/critique/resolve-references.ts and _resolve_corpus_root_references
in scenario.py. Both sides materialize `tree`, resolve the skill's agents, and compare the resulting
plugin-root-relative paths to `expected` LITERALLY. The expectations are hand-written: deriving them
from either implementation makes the pin a tautology that passes while the two disagree.
Covers CLAUSES 1 and 2 only. Clause 3 (a reference the graded agent READ during the turn) is
run-dependent and cannot be mirrored by a static linter, so it is deliberately absent here.
Every case uses the <root>/skills/<name>/ layout, the only shape scenario.py resolves a root from.
NOTE: the Python half runs only in CI's `python` job -- `npm run ci` never runs pytest.

cases.name: the ARMING form: a directory token plus bare backticked filenames
arming does not carry to the next line
a directory token ALONE packages nothing (never recurse into wholesale)
a BARE references/x.md means the SKILL's own file, not the root's
a relative path that escapes INTO the root references dir
link found only in the skill's OWN references/**, never in SKILL.md
link from an AGENT body, incl. frontmatter and an unbalanced trailing paren

tree.agents/ms.md:
---
name: ms
description: (see plug/references/shared.md): does things
---
body

cases.name: a nested root reference resolves through its subdirectory
a cross-plugin-looking prefix that is not this plugin does not resolve
